question: Which kind names a monthly credit grant in limits[].kind and binding: request-rate (the store defines it as requests per unit of time) or volume-quota (dossier/README.md defines it as a byte allowance over a period)? In the store at commit 0398f4dc0405, 22 of 38 non-duplicate records whose free-tier unit is credits bind on request-rate and 8 on volume-quota; Crawl4AI's record files its 1,000 credits a month as request-rate, as the five other crawler-scraper credit records do.
why: a credit is a billed call and not a byte, yet the corpus files credit pools under both kinds, so a filter on either kind returns a different mix of services; a term for a credit allowance per period, or a definition that names the kind a credit pool takes, would settle it
